purpose: Prototype/test fixtures for the land-geospatial-data-smart-system workflow

prototype_threshold.note: Configurable prototype fixture only. This package does not establish a legal or final geometric threshold definition.

source_like_inputs: Urban Local Body / Municipal Corporation (synthetic Meerut Nagar Nigam building records)
Directorate of Land Records / Cadastral System (synthetic Bhu-Naksha parcels)

synthetic_stage_test_cases.STR-004: small parcel overflow geometry (about 5 m boundary exceedance) -> intended small-overflow fixture
synthetic_stage_test_cases.STR-005: medium parcel overflow geometry (about 15 m boundary exceedance) -> intended audit_pending fixture under a 10 m distance-style prototype metric
synthetic_stage_test_cases.STR-006: large parcel overflow geometry (about 30 m boundary exceedance) -> intended disputed fixture under a 10 m distance-style prototype metric
synthetic_stage_test_cases.STR-007: structure crosses two neighboring parcels -> multi-parcel/human-audit fixture

notes: GeoTIFF is intentionally omitted as requested.
GeoJSON uses WGS84 coordinates for interoperability; processing_crs identifies the synthetic projected CRS used to construct the geometry.
Department CSVs deliberately contain conflicting values and one or more missing values so Stage 3 conflict resolution can be tested.
These records are synthetic and must never be treated as real government records.
